rules.description: Movix - HTML et fichiers de pilotage hors cache
Movix - Medias publics selon les en-tetes origine
rules.expression: ((http.host in {"{{DOMAIN}}" "www.{{DOMAIN}}"}) and ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/avatars/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/live/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/help/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/WatchpartyTutorial/")) or http.request.uri.path in {"/apothecary_backdrop.jpg" "/apple-touch-icon-180.png" "/favicon-48.png" "/movix-192.png" "/movix.png" "/movix.svg" "/movix512.png" "/thumbnail.png"}) and lower(http.request.uri.path.extension) in {"png" "jpg" "jpeg" "gif" "webp" "avif" "svg" "ico" "woff" "woff2" "ttf" "otf" "eot" "mp4" "webm" "m4v" "mp3"}) and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "authorization")

rules.description: Movix - Assets Vite immuables selon origine, erreurs exclues
rules.expression: (http.host in {"{{DOMAIN}}" "www.{{DOMAIN}}"}) and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "authorization")

rules.description: Movix - HTML public selon origine (60 s au prochain frontend)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"{{DOMAIN}}" "www.{{DOMAIN}}"}) and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.html" "/movies" "/anime" "/tv-shows" "/collections" "/search" "/about" "/privacy" "/terms-of-service" "/extension" "/app" "/list-catalog" "/top10" "/calendar" "/live-tv" "/cinegraph"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/movie/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tv/")) and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "authorization")
